fusions.name: Flattening Stamp
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a stamp that deals 24 blunt damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warning Thump
fusions.desc: Thumps the ground, dealing 4 blunt damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Ground
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Coiled Weight
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack, 30% at full, for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
